const char* bypass_name[] = { "BypassTPMCheck", "BypassSecureBootCheck", "BypassRAMCheck" };
"<unattend xmlns=\"urn:schemas-microsoft-com:unattend\">\n"
"  <settings pass=\"windowsPE\">\n"
"    <component name=\"Microsoft-Windows-Setup\" processorArchitecture=\"%s\" language=\"neutral\" "
"      <UserData>\n"
"        <AcceptEula>true</AcceptEula>\n"
"        <ProductKey>\n"
"          <Key />\n"
"        </ProductKey>\n"
"      </UserData>\n"
"              <Order>1</Order>\n"
"              <Order>2</Order>\n"
"              <Order>3</Order>\n"
"              <Key>/IMAGE/INDEX</Key>\n"
"              <Value>%d</Value>\n"
"      <RunSynchronous>\n"
"        <RunSynchronousCommand wcm:action=\"add\">\n"
"          <Order>%d</Order>\n"
"          <Path>reg add HKLM\\SYSTEM\\Setup\\LabConfig /v %s /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f</Path>\n"
"        </RunSynchronousCommand>\n"
"      </RunSynchronous>\n"
"    </component>\n"
"    <component name=\"Microsoft-Windows-International-Core-WinPE\" processorArchitecture=\"%s\" language=\"neutral\" "
"  </settings>\n"
"  <settings pass=\"specialize\">\n"
"    <component name=\"Microsoft-Windows-Deployment\" processorArchitecture=\"%s\" language=\"neutral\" "
"reg add \"HKLM\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\OOBE\" /v BypassNRO /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f"
"          <Path>%s</Path>\n"
"  <settings pass=\"oobeSystem\">\n"
"    <component name=\"Microsoft-Windows-Shell-Setup\" processorArchitecture=\"%s\" language=\"neutral\" "
"      <OOBE>\n"
"        <HideEULAPage>true</HideEULAPage>\n"
"        <ProtectYourPC>3</ProtectYourPC>\n"
"      </OOBE>\n"
"      <UserAccounts>\n"
"        <LocalAccounts>\n"
"          <LocalAccount wcm:action=\"add\">\n"
"            <Name>%s</Name>\n"
"            <DisplayName>%s</DisplayName>\n"
"            <Group>Administrators;Power Users</Group>\n"
"            <Password>\n"
"              <Value>UABhAHMAcwB3AG8AcgBkAA==</Value>\n"
"              <PlainText>false</PlainText>\n"
"            </Password>\n"
"          </LocalAccount>\n"
"        </LocalAccounts>\n"
"      </UserAccounts>\n"
"net user \"%s\" /logonpasswordchg:yes"
"      <FirstLogonCommands>\n"
"        <SynchronousCommand wcm:action=\"add\">\n"
"          <CommandLine>%s</CommandLine>\n"
"        </SynchronousCommand>\n"
"      </FirstLogonCommands>\n"
"    <component name=\"Microsoft-Windows-International-Core\" processorArchitecture=\"%s\" language=\"neutral\" "
"    <component name=\"Microsoft-Windows-SecureStartup-FilterDriver\" processorArchitecture=\"%s\" language=\"neutral\" "
"    <component name=\"Microsoft-Windows-EnhancedStorage-Adm\" processorArchitecture=\"%s\" language=\"neutral\" "
"  <settings pass=\"offlineServicing\">\n"
"    <component name=\"Microsoft-Windows-PartitionManager\" processorArchitecture=\"%s\" language=\"neutral\" "
"    <component name=\"Microsoft-Windows-CodeIntegrity\" processorArchitecture=\"%s\" language=\"neutral\" "
"</unattend>\n"
